q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE NAME NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT S.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S LEFT JOIN ORDERS AS O ON S.SALES_ID = O.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE 'RED' = C.NAME )
